# Sharethrough
> Human-centric omnichannel supply-side platform for programmatic advertising, helping advertisers and publishers improve outcomes with advanced RTB technology and enhanced ad experiences.

Sharethrough provides solutions for brands, agencies, and publishers across channels including display, video, native, and CTV. Its site includes product overviews, ad enhancement examples, sustainability tools, case studies, company information, and support resources.

## Advertiser Solutions
- [Advertiser Solutions](https://www.sharethrough.com/advertisers): Overview of Sharethrough’s programmatic solutions for brands and agencies across channels.
- [Ad Enhancements](https://www.sharethrough.com/advertisers/ad-enhancements): Product overview for creative enhancements applied to standard ad formats.
- [CTV Sports Ticker](https://www.sharethrough.com/advertisers/ad-enhancements/ctv-sports-ticker): Example creative gallery page showcasing a CTV ad enhancement format.
- [Curation](https://www.sharethrough.com/advertisers/curation): Overview of curation capabilities for improving media quality and performance.
- [Inventory Curation](https://www.sharethrough.com/advertisers/curation/inventory-curation): Details on curated inventory packages for advertisers and agencies.
- [Cookieless Advertising](https://www.sharethrough.com/advertisers/cookieless-advertising): Addressability approach for advertising in privacy-conscious, cookieless environments.
- [Sustainability](https://www.sharethrough.com/advertisers/sustainability): Advertiser-focused sustainability solutions for reducing media carbon impact.

## Publisher Solutions
- [Publisher Solutions](https://www.sharethrough.com/publishers): Overview of monetization and supply-side solutions for publishers.
- [SmartSuite™ Technology](https://www.sharethrough.com/publishers/smartsuite-technology): Publisher technology suite designed to improve monetization and ad quality.
- [Publisher Sustainability](https://www.sharethrough.com/publishers/sustainability): Sustainability program information for publishers seeking lower-emission advertising operations.

## Case Studies
- [Advertiser Case Studies](https://www.sharethrough.com/advertisers/case-studies): Collection of customer stories and campaign performance examples.
- [CafeMedia Case Study](https://www.sharethrough.com/advertisers/case-studies/how-cafemedia-has-seen-consistent-growth-since-integration-with-sharethrough): Publisher growth case study following integration with Sharethrough.

## Sustainability & Measurement
- [Carbon Emissions Estimator](https://www.sharethrough.com/carbon-emissions-estimator): Tool for estimating carbon emissions associated with digital advertising campaigns.
- [Advertiser Sustainability](https://www.sharethrough.com/advertisers/sustainability): Sustainability capabilities for advertisers focused on lower-impact media buying.
- [Net Zero Publisher Program](https://www.sharethrough.com/publishers/sustainability): Publisher sustainability initiative aligned with net-zero advertising goals.

## Campaigns & Featured Content
- [CTV Ad Enhancements Campaign](https://www.sharethrough.com/campaigns/sharethrough-ctv-ad-enhancements): Featured page explaining Sharethrough’s CTV ad enhancement offering.
- [Political Advertising](https://www.sharethrough.com/campaigns/increase-candidate-consideration-this-upcoming-election): Campaign page focused on political advertising and candidate consideration outcomes.

## Company
- [Company](https://www.sharethrough.com/company): Overview of Sharethrough’s business, mission, and market positioning.
- [Leadership](https://www.sharethrough.com/company/leadership): Leadership team page with executive information.

## Support
- [Support Center](https://support.sharethrough.com/hc/en-us): Help center for platform support, troubleshooting, and operational guidance.

## Key Product Areas
- [Advertiser Solutions](https://www.sharethrough.com/advertisers): Central hub for advertiser products, channels, and performance capabilities.
- [Publisher Solutions](https://www.sharethrough.com/publishers): Central hub for publisher monetization and supply management offerings.
- [Ad Enhancements](https://www.sharethrough.com/advertisers/ad-enhancements): Core product area focused on improving standard ad formats automatically.
- [Curation](https://www.sharethrough.com/advertisers/curation): Core product area for curated supply and inventory packaging.
- [SmartSuite™ Technology](https://www.sharethrough.com/publishers/smartsuite-technology): Core publisher technology offering for optimization and monetization.
